abstract: Cloudways costs less to start and lists more AI tools. Kinsta costs more and lists a money-back guarantee and human support.

name: Jamil Ahmed
description: Founder and CEO of Reinforce Lab. Pharmacist, SEO and AI search consultant, and Semrush Ambassador.

acceptedAnswer.text: Neither wins every round. Cloudways costs less to start and lists more AI tools. Kinsta lists human support and a 30-day money-back guarantee.

mainEntity.name: Which is cheaper, Cloudways or Kinsta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloudways' entry plan lists at $14 a month and Kinsta's at $35 a month. The plans are not the same size.

mainEntity.name: Which has the better Black Friday deal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cloudways offers 80% off for 2 months with no end date shown. Kinsta offers 50% off for 3 months, or 3 months free on annual billing, ending 1 December 2026.
The tests used different servers and methods. EXPERTE measured 99.977% uptime for Kinsta, and DevOpsCube measured a GTmetrix grade of A for Cloudways. They are not directly comparable.
Yes. Kinsta hosts WordPress only. Cloudways hosts WordPress and other apps.
